entities.name: Saint Wenceslaus I, Duke of Bohemia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wenceslaus I, Wenceslas I or Václav the Good was the Prince (kníže) of Bohemia from 921 until his death, probably in 935. According to the legend, he was assassinated by his younger brother, Boleslaus the Cruel.
